title: Senior Backend Engineer (Golang)
description:
OPEN TO ALL CANDIDATES ACROSS LATIN AMERICA


Title:  Senior Backend Engineer (Golang) – Data Infrastructure & Recommendations

Company:  Fulcrum SaaS

Location: Remote – Latin America (strong overlap with Americas time zones required)

Type:  Full-time

Level:  Senior / Staff

Compensation:  USD 70,000–100,000 per year, depending on experience and location


About Fulcrum SaaS

Fulcrum SaaS is a conversion rate optimization (CRO) platform that powers product recommendations for ecommerce brands. Our infrastructure processes high-volume behavioral events, feeds real-time recommendation algorithms, and serves personalized experiences at scale. We operate in a multi-tenant SaaS environment where data correctness, low latency, and system reliability are non-negotiable.

Our stack includes Go, Bigtable, BigQuery, Pub/Sub, and a dual-store architecture (operational + analytical) that we designed from scratch.


The Role

We are looking for a senior backend engineer who has built and operated production data systems under real load—not prototypes, not internal tools. This is a core infrastructure role at the intersection of our operational and analytical data layers.

You will own the systems that move behavioral event data from ingestion through transformation into our recommendation engine. You will design for correctness, build for observability, and make architectural tradeoffs with the pragmatism that only comes from production scars.

You will be an early engineering hire with real influence over our technical direction.


What You’ll Do

  • Design and operate high-throughput event ingestion pipelines capable of processing millions of events per day with low-latency serving requirements.
  • Own the dual-store architecture that separates our operational (real-time) and analytical (batch) data layers, including streaming vs. batch pipeline design and failure recovery.
  • Build and maintain data movement infrastructure between stores (Bigtable/BigQuery or comparable), ensuring consistency, at-least-once delivery, and graceful degradation.
  • Instrument production systems: define SLOs, implement distributed tracing, and build alerting that distinguishes signal from noise.
  • Partner with the recommendation team to evolve our scoring, waterfall, and ranking infrastructure.
  • Drive architectural decisions on data modeling, schema evolution, and multi-tenant isolation.
  • Participate in an on-call rotation and own incidents end-to-end—from detection through root cause analysis to postmortem.


What We’re Looking For (Must-Haves)

  • 5–10+ years of hands-on backend engineering in production environments (more is better).
  • Track record of building and operating high-performance, high-throughput, low-latency systems at scale—not just prototypes.
  • Deep working knowledge of Go’s concurrency model (goroutines, channels, context, sync primitives)—beyond syntax familiarity.
  • Experience with columnar or wide-column stores: Bigtable/BigQuery strongly preferred; Cassandra, DynamoDB, Redshift, or Snowflake are comparable.
  • Hands-on experience moving data between operational and analytical stores—you have solved streaming vs. batch tradeoffs, handled delivery guarantees, and recovered from pipeline failures.
  • Experience with production observability: metrics, tracing, alerting, dashboards—you know what good instrumentation looks like.
  • Multi-tenant SaaS experience—you understand isolation, scaling, and noisy-neighbor challenges when serving multiple customers on shared infrastructure.
  • Batch pipeline design experience—you know when batch is the right tool and how to make it reliable.
  • Dual-store architecture experience—you have operated systems where the operational and analytical data layers are intentionally separate.
  • Comfortable working daily in English with a US-based team (meetings, async communication, code reviews, and technical documentation).


Strong Nice-to-Haves

  • Identity resolution and cross-device stitching (probabilistic or deterministic).
  • A/B testing infrastructure built for statistical rigor—not just feature flags, but impression tracking, experiment analysis, and statistical significance frameworks.
  • Recommendation systems experience: scoring heuristics, waterfall algorithms, collaborative filtering, or hybrid approaches.
  • Ecommerce domain knowledge: attribution models, conversion tracking, order/cart data models, session stitching.


What We Offer

  • Compensation in the range of USD 70,000–100,000 per year, depending on experience and location, benchmarked to senior remote engineering roles in LATAM.
  • Remote-first culture with async-friendly practices.
  • Direct access to leadership; your architectural opinions will be heard and implemented.
  • A team that treats production reliability as a first-class engineering concern.


How to Apply

Please apply through LinkedIn with your CV (English) and a brief note highlighting:

  • Your experience with Go in production.
  • The most demanding data/throughput system you have owned.
  • Your country of residence and preferred start date.

You can also include links to GitHub, technical blogs, or talks if available.

Preferred Qualifications

title: Cloud AI/ML Engineer
description:
Looking for an experienced Senior Cloud AI/ML Engineer to lead the automation of complex financial workflows at Prosigliere.


Description

We are seeking a Senior Cloud AI/ML Engineer with a \"cloud-first\" mindset to join our growing team. In this role, you won't just build models; you will architect end-to-end intelligent systems that redefine how we handle financial data. You will be responsible for analyzing manual credit request processes and identifying opportunities to automate them using cutting-edge cloud AI services.

The ideal candidate bridges the gap between raw data and actionable business intelligence, building tools that ingest high-stakes data from credit agencies, analyze it through sophisticated AI pipelines, and present it via human-in-the-loop dashboards. You will work closely with engineering leadership to turn manual bottlenecks into scalable, automated cloud solutions.


Responsibilities

  • Process Architecture: Analyze existing credit request workflows to identify automation opportunities using cloud-native AI/ML solutions.
  • Intelligent Data Ingestion: Design and implement processes utilizing Document Intelligence (OCR/Form parsing), and Web Search integration to gather and structure fragmented data.
  • Third-Party Data Synthesis: Build tools to ingest and analyze complex results from credit agencies (e.g., D&B, Experian, Equifax ) to drive automated decision-making.
  • Custom Tooling: Develop custom software bridges to fill gaps between standard cloud AI services and specific business requirements.
  • Human-in-the-Loop Systems: Create intuitive dashboards that visualize AI-driven analysis, allowing human reviewers to audit and approve automated recommendations.
  • Cloud Deployment: Deploy and maintain robust MLOps pipelines in a cloud environment, ensuring high reliability and security for sensitive financial data.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Communicate technical AI concepts to non-technical stakeholders and collaborate with backend teams to ensure seamless data flow.


Technology Requirements

title: Remote Appointment Setter
description:
B2B Appointment Setter - Uncapped Income (Base + Pay Per Call)


Connect With Us:


  • LinkedIn:
  • Twitter/X:
  • Company: gpsocials.com 


This position is fully remote. We're specifically hiring from LATAM and you must be available to work EST business hours for real-time collaboration.


Apply Here (See Instructions Below)


(


The Opportunity: Why GP Socials


We're not just another content agency. We're a fully remote content growth partner managing 100,000+ followers and generating hundreds of thousands of monthly views for our B2B clients. Some of whom are making $8,000,000+ in annual revenue. Plus, we've tripled our own revenue in the last year.


Here's What Makes Us Different:


  • Proven Growth Track Record : We've 3x'd our business while maintaining quality - our clients' content actually generates leads and builds brands
  • ⚡ Small Team = Massive Growth Potential : Work directly with the founder, acquire skills rapidly, and shape the trajectory of a fast-scaling agency
  • Real Impact, Real Results : The calls you book directly fuel our growth and put you at the center of every new client we sign.


Your Mission (Should You Choose to Accept It):


You'll own the top of our sales pipeline - turning LinkedIn conversations and inbound leads into booked calls on Braden's calendar. This isn't about spray-and-pray outreach or copy-paste scripts. You'll build real conversations with B2B founders and marketers, qualify them fast, and hand off warm, ready-to-buy prospects. Every call you book is a shot at a high paying client for GP Socials.


The Role: B2B Appointment Setter

Core Responsibilities:


1. LinkedIn Outbound & Conversation Management

  • Run daily LinkedIn outreach to qualified B2B founders, marketers, and decision-makers
  • Use AI to personalize opening messages based on the prospect's content, company, and role (no generic blasts)
  • Manage 50-100+ active LinkedIn conversations at a time without dropping threads
  • Handle objections in DMs and move qualified prospects toward a booked call
  • Track every conversation in our CRM with clear status, notes, and next steps

2. Inbound Lead Follow-Up

  • Respond to inbound leads from our content, referrals, and marketing FAST
  • Qualify leads against our ICP (B2B businesses doing $1M-$10M in revenue)
  • Book discovery calls directly onto Braden's calendar
  • Send pre-call confirmations and reduce no-show rates with reminder sequences

3. Pipeline Hygiene & Reporting

  • Keep the CRM clean: accurate stages, follow-up tasks, and conversation history
  • Report daily on outreach sent, replies, booked calls, and show rates
  • Flag patterns in objections and reply data so we can sharpen our messaging
  • Follow written SOPs for outreach cadences, qualification, and handoff


Who You Are: Non-Negotiables & Must-Haves


Deal-Makers (You Need ALL of These):

  • ✅ B2B Agency or SaaS Setting Experience: I do not care about years worked. All I care about is if you have booked calls with B2B businesses
  • ✅ Writes Like a Human: You can write DMs that sound like a real person, not a bot. You understand tone, pacing, and how to earn a reply in 2-3 sentences.
  • ✅ Fluent Written English: Your written English is clean enough that founders in the US won't clock you as a non-native speaker over DM. (Spoken English is a plus, but writing is the non-negotiable.)
  • ✅ CRM Discipline: You don't forget follow-ups, you don't lose threads, and you can be trusted to keep the pipeline clean without reminders. I should be able to look in the CRM and understand everything
  • ✅ Availability: Available to work EST business hours (9am-5pm EST) Monday-Friday for real-time collaboration and inbound response.

Deal-Breakers (Any of These = Not a Fit):

  • ❌ No proven B2B setting experience 
  • ❌ Rely on copy-paste templates and mass-blast tactics
  • ❌ Written English that reads as broken, stiff, or obviously AI-generated
  • ❌ Can't show specific numbers (calls booked, show rate, deals closed-won) from a previous setting role
  • ❌ Unwilling to work EST hours or live inside a CRM all day
  • ❌ Looking for a passive role


You're Perfect If You:

  • Get fired up about finding the exact line that makes a cold prospect say \"yeah, let's talk\"
  • Think in reply rates, show rates, and close rates - not just messages sent
  • Treat DMs like a craft, not a grind
  • Have run setting for a B2B agency or SaaS before and can talk about what worked and what flopped


The Package: What's In It for You


Compensation:

  • Base: $1,500 USD/month
  • Performance Bonus: $50 USD per booked call that shows up to the discovery call
  • Our Target: 20+ booked calls per month (realistic earnings $2,500+/month, uncapped)
  • The more calls you book, the more we make and the more you make. No ceiling.


The Perks:

  • Fully remote - work from anywhere in LATAM with a laptop and stable internet
  • ⚡ Work directly with the founder - no sales manager layers, no bureaucracy
  • Rapid skill acquisition - you'll learn B2B sales, positioning, and pipeline management from the inside of a scaling agency

title: Senior Estimator
description:
Company Overview:

Our ingenuity fuels daily life. Together, we’ve forged some of the most trusted partnerships across the energy value chain to make what was once just an idea a reality: laying subsea infrastructure thousands of feet below sea level, installing platforms hundreds of miles from shore, using our expertise to design and build offshore wind infrastructure, and reshaping the onshore landscape to deliver the energy products the world needs safely and sustainably.


For more than 100 years, we've been making the impossible possible. Today, we're driving the energy transition with more than 30,000 of the brightest minds across 54 countries.


Job Overview:

The Senior Estimator uses best practices and knowledge of internal or external issues to improve the estimating discipline within McDermott. They will act as a resource for colleagues with less experience and share their conceptual and practical expertise related to the estimating discipline. The Senior Estimator solves complex problems and uses their discipline-specific knowledge to improve their products or services. The Senior Estimator impacts a range of customer, operational, project, or service activities with the estimating team and other related teams and ensures that they are working within the appropriate guidelines and policies.


Job Responsibility:

  • Review, query, and understand the scope of work in order to prepare a proper estimate and direct attention to those areas that appear inconsistent or contain a high-risk element .
  • Support the PMT team to generate the Marine/Offshore Estimate for the Preliminary stage to ensure Bid No Bid.
  • Review the Project Plan along with the project planner and prepare subcontract scope packages for any work that is required to be subcontracted.
  • Gather information and input from functions with support from the Project Manager.
  • Consult with Subject Matter Expert (SME) to discuss Estimates and resolve issues.
  • Generate estimates with available Benchmark data and from experience prior to receiving the inputs from functions and evaluate the estimates received from functions against the internal estimate
  • Liaise with Project Team members plus all functional departments based on the specific functions allotted for a project, subcontractors and vendors, and Customer; including Procurement, Fabrication, Marine, Quality, HSES, Completions, and Welding Technology
  • Provide input to the Project Estimators, along with Basis of Estimate and Bench Markers
  • Give regular updates to the department manager/PMT /immediate supervisor and highlight any concerns about anything that might potentially jeopardize submitting a competitive proposal.
  • Analyze the cost components that are critical/crucial and seek quotes for applicable items.
  • Participate in Bid review meetings, estimate evaluation meetings, Risk assessment meetings, as well as any additional bid-related meetings, as required.
  • Prepare a comprehensive Basis of Estimate (BOE).
  • Review and identify contract price form.
  • Understand and clarify unit rate and lump sum breakdowns.
  • Accurately manage all the Previous Tender information and Treat it with Confidentiality
  • Utilize support from the benchmarking team (SMEs) by analyzing information on the costs from other similar projects and preparing the relevant benchmark report.
  • Attend and participate in Bid review meetings, estimate evaluation meetings, Risk assessment meetings, etc., as necessary for the Project/Department/Tender
  • Participate in HAZAN, HAZID, HAZOP, and other safety /operability/ reliability studies and workshops, as necessary for Project/Tender
  • Ensure any Risk or Opportunity highlighted is Duly captured for the Management review and approval.
  • Post Tender submission provide input for the clarification.
  • Support bid handover process ensuring proper transfer of pricing basis and critical assumptions to project team.
  • Manage own time to meet objectives; forecast and plan resource requirements.
  • Incorporate project planner input to develop the cost.
  • Assure that the estimate is:
  • Completed promptly
  • Cognizant of the Bid ‘Win Strategy’
  • Aligned with planned schedeule
  • All the Risk and Opportunities highlighted.
  • With Due Basis of Estimate
  • Accurate, free of errors, omission, or hidden contingency
  • In line with the agreed execution plan
  • Evaluate and recommend ways to be more cost-effective or profitable


Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering or related technical discipline preferred. Equivalent experience will be considered.
  • Five plus (5+) years of experience in a large Engineering, Procurement, and Construction (EPC) company (preferably in Offshore/Marine Operations, and offshore estimation, ).
  • Subsea/SURF experience with Minimum 3–5 years of direct experience in subsea/SURF construction estimation, including deepwater pipeline installation, flexible/umbilical lay, subsea structure installation, and marine spread costs.
  • Experience with DSV, PLSV, and/or Heavy Construction Vessel (HCV) spread rate estimation strongly preferred.
  • Cost estimation experience, preferably in the Oil & Gas industry
  • Willingness to work overtime as necessary to meet deadlines
  • Intermediate level in Microsoft Office systems, e.g., Excel, Word, Outlook, PowerPoint, Project
  • Accurately evaluate detailed specifications that are crucial to a cost estimator’s success
  • Must pay attention to minute details because such details may impact a product’s overall cost

Must plan their work and work efficiently and accurately.

City Explorer is a global livestreaming platform connecting people and cultures through real-life, immersive content. Our Explorers livestream cities, nature, culture, and daily life worldwide, supported by professional tools, structured training, and hands-on coaching.

title: Cloud Security Engineer Sênior
description:
Quem somos nós?


Somos um ecossistema de transformação digital que combina tecnologia e visão estratégica para escalar resultados e aumentar o valor entregue aos nossos clientes. Trabalhamos na construção de soluções inovadoras e disruptivas em mais de 300 projetos com grandes empresas nacionais de múltiplos segmentos.


Nosso propósito é impactar positivamente pessoas e negócios , exponencializando cada um para atingir seu máximo potencial. Respeitamos todas as diferenças e criamos um espaço aberto e livre para você ter autonomia, expor suas ideias, aprender com os erros, se conectar com outras pessoas e gerar mudanças ao seu redor .


Se você deseja estar em um ambiente colaborativo, desafiador e que incentiva você a sempre evoluir e ser o protagonista da sua história, aqui é o seu lugar!


Antes de avançarmos, é importante você saber que:

  • Contratação: CLT
  • Modelo de Trabalho: Remoto
  • Horário: das 9h às 12h e das 13h às 18h. A jornada é flexível conforme agendas e entregas.
  • Etapas do Processo: Composto por 3 a 4 etapas, com um tempo médio de até 03 dias úteis entre uma etapa e outra.
  • Meios de Comunicação: Utilizamos E-mail e WhatsApp. Certifique-se de que essas informações estejam corretas no momento de inscrição para evitar falhas na comunicação.


O que buscamos?


Estamos em busca de um(a) Cloud Security Engineer para integrar nosso movimento. Essa pessoa será referência técnica em segurança de aplicações e infraestrutura, atuando de forma estratégica e hands-on na proteção de ambientes digitais complexos — com foco em pipelines seguros, desenvolvimento seguro e ambientes multicloud.


Como será seu dia-a-dia?


  • Projetar e revisar arquiteturas seguras para aplicações web, APIs e sites, identificando vulnerabilidades e propondo melhorias estruturais.
  • Configurar, evoluir e automatizar pipelines CI/CD no GitLab com integração de ferramentas de segurança (SAST, DAST, SCA, secrets scanning), garantindo que segurança faça parte do fluxo de entrega.
  • Apoiar times de desenvolvimento na adoção de práticas de desenvolvimento seguro (Secure SDLC), conduzindo análises de código e orientações sobre boas práticas de segurança.
  • Criar automações para monitoramento, detecção de ameaças, resposta a incidentes e hardening de ambientes, reduzindo a superfície de ataque de forma contínua.
  • Atuar na segurança de infraestruturas multicloud (AWS, Azure e/ou GCP), incluindo IAM, gestão de segredos, redes e conformidade com políticas de segurança.
  • Colaborar com squads e stakeholders técnicos para disseminar cultura de segurança, participar de revisões de arquitetura e contribuir proativamente com soluções inovadoras.
  • Manter-se atualizado(a) sobre o cenário de ameaças, CVEs relevantes e novas tecnologias de segurança, trazendo insights para o time.


Para cumprir esse desafio, você precisa ter:


  • Experiência com threat modeling, revisão de arquitetura de apps e sites, e conhecimento de OWASP Top 10 e boas práticas de segurança em APIs REST/GraphQL.
  • Domínio avançado de GitLab CI/CD, com experiência em configurar stages de segurança (SAST, DAST, SCA, secrets detection) e integrar ferramentas como Trivy, Semgrep ou similares.
  • Conhecimento de práticas como code review com foco em segurança, análise de dependências vulneráveis, gestão de segredos e políticas de controle de acesso.
  • Capacidade de desenvolver scripts, playbooks e automações (Python, Bash ou similares) para triagem de alertas, resposta a incidentes e hardening de ambientes.
  • Experiência em ao menos um provedor (AWS, Azure ou GCP) com foco em IAM, segurança de redes, gestão de segredos (Vault, KMS) e conformidade (CIS Benchmarks, CSPM).
  • Familiaridade com OWASP ZAP, Burp Suite, Snyk, SonarQube, Checkov, Prowler ou equivalentes.


Você irá se destacar se:


  • Conhecimento de frameworks como NIST, ISO 27001 ou SOC 2.


O que oferecemos aos nossos Builders?


  • Auxílio Alimentação (VA/VR) no cartão Caju;
  • Auxílio Home-Office no cartão Caju;
  • Programa de Pontos Flexíveis em seu Caju - um valor fléxivel para você usar como você quiser;
  • Plano de Saúde Nacional Porto Seguro (Plano Prata com apartamento e sem coparticipação) com 50% da mensalidade custeada pela Builders;
  • Assistência Odontológica pela Porto Seguro (Plano Bronze) com 100% da mensalidade paga pela Builders;
  • Auxílio Creche para crianças de até 72 meses;
  • Auxílio à Saúde Mental - acesso ao aplicativo Vida+;
  • Auxílio à Saúde Física - acesso ao aplicativo Gympass;
  • Seguro de vida.


Todas as nossas vagas são inclusivas e abertas a pessoas de todas as identidades de gênero, orientações sexuais, idades, etnias, culturas, origens, crenças, deficiências e outras diversidades. Acreditamos que a pluralidade enriquece nosso time e promove um ambiente de trabalho mais inovador e colaborativo.

Why Work With Us:

Buscamos um(a) profissional com perfil player-coach , capaz de equilibrar uma atuação técnica hands-on com a liderança de equipe, sendo responsável por guiar o time na construção de uma infraestrutura de dados moderna, escalável e orientada ao negócio. É essencial possuir inglês avançado ou fluente para conversação , já que a posição envolve interação constante com times e stakeholders internacionais. A contratação é no modelo CLT , com atuação 100% remota .


Principais Responsabilidades:


Atuação Estratégica e Técnica

  • Atuar como engenheiro(a) sênior, participando diretamente do desenvolvimento (design, codificação e entrega de features).
  • Liderar o desenho e evolução da arquitetura de dados, garantindo escalabilidade, confiabilidade e performance.
  • Trabalhar com tecnologias modernas como Snowflake, Databricks e serviços em cloud (AWS/Azure).
  • Gerenciar e desenvolver o time, promovendo um ambiente colaborativo e de alta performance.
  • Incentivar o crescimento técnico e de carreira dos engenheiros.
  • Atuar em conjunto com Product Managers na descoberta e definição de soluções, garantindo alinhamento com necessidades do negócio.
  • Definir e garantir boas práticas de arquitetura, engenharia e metodologias ágeis.
  • Gerenciar e reduzir dívida técnica da plataforma.
  • Liderar iniciativas de análise, planejamento e execução de projetos de dados.
  • Garantir entregas consistentes e alinhadas com os objetivos estratégicos.


Responsabilidades do Dia a Dia:

  • Desenvolver e otimizar pipelines de dados e processos de ETL (Airbyte, Fivetran, Azure Data Factory).
  • Construir e manter infraestrutura de dados robusta e escalável.
  • Trabalhar de forma colaborativa com times de dados, produto, engenharia e stakeholders de negócio.
  • Gerenciar infraestrutura com práticas modernas (Terraform, Ansible, Azure Application Insights).
  • Garantir governança, qualidade e confiabilidade dos dados.
  • Atuar na operação de ambientes produtivos, incluindo suporte a incidentes críticos.
  • Promover inovação contínua e adoção de novas tecnologias, incluindo uso de IA no ciclo de desenvolvimento.


Requisitos Técnicos (Obrigatórios)

  • Experiência sólida com pipelines de dados, ETL e ambientes produtivos.
  • Experiência com Airbyte, Fivetran, Snowflake, Databricks e Azure Data Factory.
  • Forte domínio de SQL e modelagem de dados (incluindo grandes volumes).
  • Experiência com ferramentas de BI como Power BI e Sigma.
  • Conhecimento em Infraestrutura como Código (Terraform, Ansible).
  • Programação em Python (diferencial: Scala).
  • Experiência com Docker e Kubernetes.
  • Conhecimento em data lakes, bancos relacionais, NoSQL e OLAP.
  • Boa comunicação e visão orientada a produto.
  • Inglês fluente.


Diferenciais

  • Experiência com pipelines de AI/ML e serviços como AWS SageMaker ou Azure Synapse.
  • Vivência com governança de dados e qualidade.
  • Background em sistemas distribuídos, APIs ou arquiteturas orientadas a eventos.


Formação e Experiência

  • Mais de 6 anos de experiência em Data Engineering (hands-on).
  • Mais de 3 anos liderando times ou iniciativas de dados.
  • Formação em Ciência da Computação, Data Science ou áreas correlatas.

title: Product Owner - Sênior
description:
Product Owner - Sênior

A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui.


Sobre a Rethink

Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital , ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala.


Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos.


Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado.

Diversidade e Inclusão

Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos . Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência .

Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente?

Qual será o seu papel?

No seu dia a dia, você gerenciará o backlog do produto, priorizando funcionalidades com base no valor para o negócio, impacto operacional e necessidades regulatórias. Atuará como principal interlocutor entre as áreas de negócio (operações, comercial, regulatório, supply chain) e os times de desenvolvimento, traduzindo necessidades de negócio em requisitos técnicos claros e viáveis. Você liderará cerimônias ágeis e garantirá a entrega contínua de valor, promovendo melhorias incrementais nos processos de distribuição de gás. Além disso, acompanhará métricas de desempenho do produto (KPIs de negócio e de uso), proporá evoluções baseadas em dados e feedback dos usuários, e garantirá que as soluções desenvolvidas estejam em conformidade com as normas de segurança e regulação do setor de gás.


Como será seu dia a dia?

  • Gerenciar o backlog do produto, priorizando funcionalidades com base no valor para o negócio, impacto operacional e necessidades regulatórias.
  • Atuar como principal interlocutor(a) entre áreas de negócio (operações, comercial, regulatório e supply chain) e os times de desenvolvimento, traduzindo necessidades em requisitos técnicos claros e viáveis.
  • Liderar cerimônias ágeis e garantir a entrega contínua de valor para o produto.
  • Promover melhorias incrementais nos processos de distribuição de gás.
  • Acompanhar métricas de desempenho (KPIs de negócio e de uso), analisando dados para direcionar evoluções do produto.
  • Propor melhorias com base em dados e feedbacks dos usuários.
  • Garantir que as soluções estejam em conformidade com normas de segurança e regulação do setor.


Para esta vaga, é essencial:

  • Visão holística e estratégica, com capacidade de compreender o negócio de distribuição de gás de ponta a ponta, conectando iniciativas de tecnologia às metas do negócio.
  • Perfil de liderança com forte viés de execução, sendo “mão na massa”, orientado(a) a resultados e capaz de remover impedimentos para garantir entregas com qualidade e agilidade.
  • Excelente comunicação e habilidade de transitar entre áreas, atuando como ponte entre negócio e tecnologia.
  • Sólido conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe) e práticas de gestão de produto (roadmaps, OKRs, MVPs).
  • Experiência na liderança de squads multidisciplinares e atuação em ciclos de discovery e delivery.
  • Formação superior em Administração, Engenharia, Ciência da Computação ou áreas correlatas.


Você pode se destacar se:

  • Possuir pós-graduação ou MBA em Gestão de Negócios, Energia ou Transformação Digital.
  • Tiver certificações em Product Ownership (CSPO, PSPO) e metodologias ágeis (CSM, SAFe).
  • Tiver familiaridade com o setor de gás e energia, incluindo regulação da ANP e processos como medição, faturamento, logística e segurança operacional.
  • Demonstrar forte visão sistêmica e pensamento crítico.
  • Apresentar habilidade de negociação e influência.
  • Ser resiliente e adaptável em ambientes de alta complexidade.
  • Ter perfil colaborativo e facilitador.
  • Demonstrar orientação a resultados e senso de urgência.
  • Possuir experiência em contextos dinâmicos.

Curtiu a oportunidade?

Então, vem repensar o futuro com a gente! ✨

title: Analista / Consultor(a) Oracle EBS Financials (FA) — PIS/COFINS
description:
Analista / Consultor Oracle Financials (FA) — PIS/COFINS

Especialista em ERP Financeiro com foco em apuração e adequação às novas regras de PIS/COFINS

Sobre a oportunidade

Buscamos um profissional com sólida experiência em Oracle Financials (FA) para atuar em um projeto estratégico de análise e adequação do sistema ERP às novas regras de PIS/COFINS. O ambiente é de sistema não nativo, com alto volume de customizações, exigindo capacidade analítica para entender o estado atual da solução, identificar gaps e propor as adaptações necessárias para conformidade fiscal.


Principais responsabilidades

Analisar o funcionamento atual do sistema ERP Oracle FA no que tange ao processo de apuração de PIS/COFINS, mapeando fluxos, regras de negócio e customizações existentes.

Identificar gaps entre a situação atual do sistema e os requisitos exigidos pela nova legislação de PIS/COFINS, propondo soluções de adequação.

Trabalhar com regime misto de apuração (cumulativo e não cumulativo), com foco especial na tomada de crédito pelas entradas.

Especificar e acompanhar as customizações e adaptações sistêmicas necessárias para atender às novas obrigações fiscais, em parceria com equipes técnicas e de desenvolvimento.

Documentar processos de negócio e requisitos funcionais (AS IS / TO BE), garantindo rastreabilidade das decisões e aderência à legislação vigente.

Apoiar testes, homologação e validação das entregas sistêmicas, assegurando conformidade tributária e integridade dos dados fiscais.


Diferenciais desejáveis

Experiência anterior em projetos de adequação fiscal e reforma tributária em sistemas ERP.

Conhecimento em SPED Contribuições (EFD-Contribuições) e obrigações acessórias relacionadas.

Noções de SQL para análise e validação de dados em ambiente Oracle.

Graduação em Ciências Contábeis, Administração, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas.

title: Brazil - Business Development Manager (Medical Devices)
description:
About Taevas

Taevas Life Sciences is a medical technology company delivering advanced diagnostic devices across areas such as audiology, balance & vestibular care, sleep therapy, and imaging.


We focus on providing high-quality, clinician-designed solutions that improve diagnostic accuracy, streamline workflows, and enhance patient care across diverse healthcare settings. With a strong emphasis on innovation, accessibility, and practical application, we support healthcare providers across India and global markets.


Website:


Job Title: Business Development Manager – Medical Devices

Location: Brazil

Employment Type: Full-Time


Role Overview

We are seeking a dynamic and results-driven Business Development Manager to lead medical device sales and commercialisation efforts in Colombia. The ideal candidate will bring strong market knowledge, an established network within the healthcare ecosystem, and the ability to drive both product and service revenue growth.


Key Responsibilities

Primary Responsibilities: Medical Device Sales & Commercialisation Strategy

Sales Strategy & Implementation

  • Develop and execute a comprehensive commercialisation strategy for assigned medical devices in the Colombian market
  • Identify target markets, customer segments, and strategic partnerships across hospitals, clinics, and distribution networks
  • Conduct product demonstrations and training sessions for healthcare professionals, including physicians, hospital staff, and distributors


Market Expansion

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with hospitals, clinics, rehabilitation/therapy centers, and distributors
  • Drive market penetration through key opinion leader (KOL) engagement and evidence-based product positioning
  • Perform competitor analysis and market research to identify new growth opportunities


Sales Targets & Performance

  • Achieve defined quarterly and annual sales targets
  • Track and report KPIs including sales performance, pipeline status, customer feedback, and competitive insights


Cross-functional Collaboration

  • Collaborate with regulatory, marketing, and operations teams to ensure compliance with Colombian regulatory requirements, including INVIMA guidelines
  • Support post-sales activities to ensure high customer satisfaction and long-term retention


Qualifications & Experience

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Pharmacy, Life Sciences, or a related field
  • Pharmacist license preferred

Technical Skills

  • Minimum 5+ years of experience in medical device sales, commercialisation, and business development
  • Strong understanding of Colombia’s healthcare system and medical device regulatory landscape (INVIMA knowledge preferred)
  • Proven experience in building and managing distributor networks and institutional relationships

Soft Skills

title: Senior Customer Success Manager — Google Ads & LinkedIn Ads
description:
Company: ScalixAI Location: Fully Remote Type: Full-time Reports to: Founder / CEO


About ScalixAI

ScalixAI is a performance-focused Google Ads and LinkedIn Ads agency built on one principle: paid media should drive real business outcomes, not vanity metrics. Founded by a former 8-year Google veteran, we work with ambitious SaaS companies, B2B brands, nonprofits, home services operators, and growth-stage businesses who expect more than dashboards — they expect partnership, strategy, and results.


We're small, sharp, and scaling. This role is central to how we grow.


The Role

We're hiring a Senior Customer Success Manager who lives at the intersection of Google Ads expertise, LinkedIn Ads fluency, and high-trust client relationships. You'll own a book of business end-to-end — from kickoff through renewal — and be the strategic voice clients rely on when they want to know why the numbers are moving and what to do next.

This isn't a reporting role. This is a thinking-partner role. You'll build campaigns that actually ladder up to revenue, translate performance into narrative, and hold the line on strategy when clients push in unproductive directions.


What You'll Own
  • Client relationships. You are the face of ScalixAI for your accounts. You lead weekly/bi-weekly calls, quarterly business reviews, and the hard conversations that come with managing paid media budgets.
  • Campaign strategy and execution. You build, optimize, and scale Google Ads (Search, PMax, Demand Gen, Display, YouTube) and LinkedIn Ads (Sponsored Content, Message Ads, Lead Gen Forms, ABM campaigns) across multiple verticals.
  • Storytelling through data. You turn performance data into a narrative the client's CEO, CMO, or founder actually wants to read. Numbers alone don't retain clients — meaning does.
  • Attribution and measurement. You set up clean measurement (GA4, LinkedIn Insight Tag, conversion APIs, offline conversion imports) and defend the integrity of attribution when the data gets messy.
  • Proactive optimization. You don't wait for the client to ask. You spot, flag, and fix.
  • Retention and expansion. You identify opportunities to expand scope and you catch churn signals before they become churn.


What We're Looking For

Required:

  • 5–8 years of hands-on paid media experience, with meaningful time spent in both Google Ads and LinkedIn Ads (not just one with a side of the other)
  • Direct, in-platform experience with Fibbler
  • Proven track record managing client relationships as the primary point of contact — ideally in an agency or consultancy setting
  • Strong storytelling ability: you can write a QBR narrative, present on Zoom with confidence, and explain a CPA spike in a way that builds trust rather than erodes it
  • Deep technical fluency in campaign architecture, bidding strategies, audience segmentation, creative testing, and conversion tracking across both platforms
  • Comfort with attribution conversations — last-click vs. data-driven, view-through, offline conversion imports, CRM-integrated measurement
  • B2B and SaaS paid media experience

Bonus:

  • HVAC, home services, or nonprofit vertical experience
  • Familiarity with tools like HubSpot, Salesforce, GA4, Looker Studio, Supermetrics, HockeyStack, or similar
  • LinkedIn Marketing Labs certification and/or Google Ads certifications
  • Experience building SOPs, onboarding docs, or client-facing collateral


Who Thrives Here
  • You treat client accounts like you own them, because at ScalixAI, you effectively do.
  • You have opinions and you can defend them — but you also know when to flex.
  • You're allergic to fluff. You'd rather say \"here's what's working, here's what isn't, here's what we're changing\" than hide behind a 40-slide deck.
  • You want to work on a team that moves fast, ships work, and treats paid media as a craft — not a commodity.


What We Offer
  • Fully remote — work from anywhere that overlaps reasonably with North American client hours
  • Direct access to the founder and real input on how the agency is built
  • A portfolio of clients who actually want to be partnered with (we screen hard at the front door)
  • Room to grow into team leadership as we scale


How to Apply

Send us:

  • A short note on the most interesting paid media problem you've solved in the last 12 months — across either Google or LinkedIn
  • Your resume or LinkedIn profile
  • One QBR, case study, or client-facing deliverable you're proud of (redact as needed)
  • We read everything. We respond to everyone who takes the time to apply thoughtfully.

title: Account Manager - Soluções de Cibersegurança
description:
1) Sobre a SolutionMall

A SolutionMall é uma plataforma global B2B focada no fornecimento de soluções integradas e produtos profissionais para projetos de infraestrutura e indústria.

Não atuamos apenas como uma plataforma tradicional de fornecimento de produtos. Damos grande importância à segurança, praticidade e adequação de sistemas e equipamentos utilizados em projetos reais, sempre considerando as necessidades de operação de longo prazo.

Na visão da SolutionMall, a cibersegurança não se limita a uma única categoria de software. Ela é um requisito essencial em sistemas, dispositivos conectados e na lógica geral de implantação de projetos. Mesmo em equipamentos básicos, valorizamos protocolos de comunicação segura, gestão de senhas, controle de acesso e proteção de privacidade. Acreditamos que a segurança deve ser incorporada desde o início no desenho do sistema, na seleção de produtos e na lógica de implementação.

Para sustentar esse princípio, a SolutionMall também dá atenção especial à verificação de cibersegurança e aos padrões de segurança em nível de dispositivo antes que os produtos sejam incorporados às soluções de projeto.

2) Visão Geral da Função

Estamos procurando um Gerente de Desenvolvimento de Negócios – Soluções de Cibersegurança para apoiar a expansão da atuação da SolutionMall no Brasil .

Esta é uma função part-time, baseada em cooperação . Procuramos alguém que possa trabalhar de forma flexível com a SolutionMall para apoiar:

  • desenvolvimento de negócios relacionados à cibersegurança
  • comunicação com clientes e educação de mercado
  • acompanhamento de oportunidades de projeto
  • promoção de conceitos de soluções orientadas à segurança
  • coordenação entre as necessidades do cliente e a direção técnica da SolutionMall

Esta posição não é destinada a um pesquisador acadêmico de segurança pura, e também não é uma vaga tradicional de vendas em tempo integral. Procuramos alguém que compreenda o valor prático da cibersegurança em sistemas reais e consiga impulsionar tanto a conscientização dos clientes quanto as oportunidades de negócio.

A função combina principalmente:

  • desenvolvimento de negócios relacionados à cibersegurança
  • promoção de soluções e conceitos
  • comunicação com clientes e parceiros
  • acompanhamento de oportunidades de projeto
  • comunicação técnico-comercial básica sobre segurança
  • cooperação no desenvolvimento de mercado de longo prazo

3) Principais Responsabilidades

Desenvolvimento de Negócios e Expansão de Mercado

  • Desenvolver oportunidades comerciais relacionadas a soluções de cibersegurança, sistemas com foco em segurança e requisitos de projeto orientados à segurança
  • Promover a abordagem da SolutionMall voltada à segurança em projetos de infraestrutura, indústria e sistemas conectados
  • Identificar clientes em potencial, parceiros, consultores, integradores e demais stakeholders de projetos que valorizem cibersegurança e proteção de privacidade
  • Ajudar a ampliar a percepção do mercado de que a cibersegurança deve ser um requisito padrão na seleção e implantação de sistemas

Comunicação com Clientes e Promoção do Conceito de Segurança

  • Comunicar aos clientes a importância prática da cibersegurança em sistemas e equipamentos conectados
  • Ajudar a explicar por que requisitos relacionados à segurança são importantes, incluindo:
  • suporte a HTTPS
  • evitar senhas simples, padrão ou fracas
  • configuração de senhas definidas pelo usuário
  • controle de permissões
  • proteção de privacidade
  • Apoiar a SolutionMall na promoção de uma mentalidade mais forte de segurança em projetos nos quais a cibersegurança ainda não seja totalmente priorizada

Acompanhamento de Oportunidades de Projeto

  • Acompanhar necessidades de clientes e oportunidades de projeto relacionadas a aplicações sensíveis à segurança
  • Ajudar a identificar em quais cenários a cibersegurança pode se tornar um fator importante na tomada de decisão do projeto
  • Apoiar discussões de projeto em que sejam relevantes seleção segura de produtos, controle de acesso ao sistema e requisitos ligados à privacidade
  • Auxiliar na conversão do interesse do cliente em discussões comerciais práticas e oportunidades concretas de projeto

Coordenação Técnica e de Soluções

  • Manter uma compreensão prática das expectativas básicas de cibersegurança para sistemas e equipamentos conectados
  • Apoiar a comunicação entre clientes e equipes da SolutionMall em relação ao posicionamento de produtos com foco em segurança
  • Ajudar a alinhar as necessidades dos clientes com a direção de soluções orientadas à segurança da SolutionMall
  • Auxiliar na apresentação da cibersegurança não apenas como um tema de conformidade, mas também como um requisito de confiança e operação de longo prazo

Relacionamento com Parceiros e Feedback de Mercado

  • Construir relacionamentos com clientes locais, parceiros de canal, consultores e stakeholders técnicos
  • Compartilhar feedback de mercado sobre conscientização dos clientes, preocupações com segurança, tendências de projeto e expectativas relacionadas à privacidade
  • Ajudar a SolutionMall a aprimorar sua abordagem comercial e sua estratégia de comunicação em oportunidades relacionadas à cibersegurança no mercado brasileiro

4) Qualificações

Requisitos

  • Mais de 2 anos de experiência em uma ou mais das seguintes áreas:
  • desenvolvimento de negócios relacionado à cibersegurança
  • vendas de soluções de segurança
  • negócios em infraestrutura de TI ou soluções de sistemas
  • coordenação técnico-comercial
  • desenvolvimento de projetos em setores sensíveis à segurança
  • Conhecimento básico de conceitos práticos de cibersegurança, como:
  • HTTPS / comunicação segura
  • segurança de senhas
  • controle de permissões
  • proteção de privacidade
  • requisitos de segurança em nível de dispositivo ou sistema
  • Capacidade de comunicar tanto o valor comercial quanto o significado técnico prático dos requisitos de cibersegurança
  • Forte capacidade de comunicação e desenvolvimento de negócios
  • Conforto para trabalhar em uma função part-time, flexível e orientada à cooperação
  • Proficiência de trabalho em inglês

Diferenciais

  • Experiência na promoção de conceitos de cibersegurança em projetos de infraestrutura, indústria, IoT ou sistemas conectados
  • Experiência com clientes que exigem maior atenção à segurança, privacidade ou conformidade
  • Familiaridade com dispositivos conectados, plataformas de monitoramento, sistemas inteligentes ou equipamentos em rede
  • Capacidade de apoiar tanto o desenvolvimento de negócios quanto o acompanhamento prático de projetos
  • Português é altamente desejável, e outros idiomas locais ou regionais podem ser uma vantagem adicional

5) Cobertura

Esta função apoia o desenvolvimento de negócios da SolutionMall em cibersegurança no Brasil .

Dependendo das oportunidades de projeto e das prioridades de mercado, o profissional selecionado poderá apoiar:

  • desenvolvimento de clientes
  • promoção de conceitos de segurança
  • acompanhamento de oportunidades
  • coordenação com parceiros
  • comunicação comercial relacionada a projetos

em mercados nos quais a conscientização sobre cibersegurança esteja se tornando cada vez mais importante para sistemas conectados e soluções de infraestrutura.

6) Modelo de Trabalho

Esta é uma função part-time sob um modelo baseado em cooperação .

Buscamos alguém que possa trabalhar com a SolutionMall de forma contínua e contribuir por meio de:

  • desenvolvimento de mercado em cibersegurança
  • acompanhamento de clientes e parceiros
  • desenvolvimento de oportunidades relacionadas à segurança
  • comunicação técnico-comercial
  • suporte à coordenação de projetos

Esta função foi desenhada para uma cooperação prática e flexível, e não para uma estrutura tradicional de trabalho integral em escritório.

7) Remuneração

A remuneração é baseada em desempenho e vinculada à contribuição real, incluindo:

  • resultados de desenvolvimento de negócios
  • acompanhamento de oportunidades de projeto
  • desenvolvimento de clientes
  • promoção de mercado relacionada à segurança
  • resultados comerciais e de projeto

A estrutura detalhada será compartilhada com os candidatos selecionados.

8) Como se Candidatar

Opção 1

Candidate-se pelo LinkedIn com uma breve introdução sobre sua experiência relevante, como por exemplo:

  • desenvolvimento de negócios em cibersegurança
  • promoção de soluções de segurança
  • projetos relacionados à segurança em TI / infraestrutura
  • sistemas relacionados à privacidade e controle de acesso
  • suporte técnico-comercial para soluções seguras

Opção 2

Envie seu CV para:

Assunto do e-mail:

Gerente de Desenvolvimento de Negócios – Soluções de Cibersegurança (Brasil)

title: Digital Business Analyst
description:
Digital Business Analyst – Shape the Future of Energy Reporting & Operations!


We are recruiting on behalf of a global energy services organisation operating across Gas & Power Services. This programme sits at the heart of operational excellence, regulatory compliance, and customer transparency - replacing fragmented, manual reporting with a scalable digital reporting solution across complex industrial assets.


You’ll join a long-term, high-impact transformation programme focused on power plant operations, Operations & Maintenance (O&M), and performance reporting. This is a discovery-heavy role with real ownership, working directly with senior stakeholders to define what the product should be, before it’s built.


As a Digital Business Analyst, you’ll lead domain discovery, define product capabilities, and act as the bridge between business stakeholders and delivery teams to turn complex operational needs into a clear, scalable digital solution.


Your Role:

You’ll be the bridge between operations, data, and delivery. This is a senior, hands-on role where you’ll rapidly onboard into the Gas & Power Services domain, lead structured discovery, and shape a digital reporting product from the ground up - with ownership through to delivery and value realisation.


What You’ll Do:

  • Lead structured interviews and workshops with domain heads and SMEs to capture current-state (“as-is”) processes, data flows, and pain points
  • Translate business needs into clear product capabilities, outcomes, and success measures
  • Define reporting requirements, data inputs, ownership models, and KPIs across performance, efficiency, safety, environmental, and financial metrics
  • Balance standardisation and configurability across plants, equipment types, and markets
  • Create and maintain product vision, roadmap, capability maps, and a prioritised backlog
  • Define the end-to-end data and reporting strategy - from data collection and validation through to dashboards and customer-facing outputs
  • Work closely with Solution Architects to ensure technical feasibility, scalability, and long-term sustainability
  • Act as the primary bridge between business stakeholders and delivery teams, driving clarity and momentum
  • Lead demos, clarify scope boundaries, and align expectations on custom vs configurable functionality
  • Support planning, estimation, sequencing, and governance across a multi-phase programme
  • Track progress against milestones and help define what success looks like by September 2026


What You Bring:

  • Proven ability to lead discovery independently and bring structure to ambiguous environments
  • Experience working on data-driven products, reporting systems, or analytics platforms
  • Experience with international, enterprise environments
  • Excellent stakeholder management and facilitation skills across senior, operational, and technical audiences
  • Confidence translating complex operational domains into clear, actionable requirements
  • Exposure to energy, utilities, power generation, or industrial operations is highly desirable
  • Familiarity with operational KPIs, asset performance management, and HSE reporting is a strong plus
  • Experience working with dashboards, BI tools, or custom reporting solutions

  • Fully remote B2B / freelance contracts
  • Access to high-impact roles across AI, FinTech, and modern infrastructure
  • A strong community of senior engineers, curated content, and role alerts
  • Work with fast-scaling companies where your impact is visible and valued

If you’re a Digital Business Analyst who thrives in discovery, enjoys shaping products from complex operational environments, and wants to deliver measurable business value in the energy sector - we’d love to hear from you.

title: Business Strategy Consultant
description:
Organizations collect mountains of data about their customers — and still struggle to act on it. They run surveys, build dashboards, and generate reports, but often lack the structured thinking to turn those outputs into decisions that actually change the business. This role exists to close that gap.


Responsibilities:

  • Diagnosing drivers of customer satisfaction, loyalty, and operational performance across enterprise clients.
  • Structuring insights from large datasets and Voice of Customer programs into strategic recommendations.
  • Developing analytical frameworks that connect behavioral and operational data to business outcomes.
  • Building executive presentations and data-driven narratives for C-level and senior stakeholders.
  • Contributing to consulting proposals and new service offerings — translating insights into commercial value propositions.
  • Supporting the development of consulting methodologies, tools, and analytical approaches.


Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Economics, Engineering, Statistics, Data Science, or Marketing.
  • 3–6 years of experience in roles such as Strategy consulting; Business analytics or insights; Strategic planning; Business intelligence or data-driven product roles.
  • Advanced Excel and PowerPoint skills.
  • Structured problem-solving and analytical framework development.
  • Ability to synthesize qualitative and quantitative inputs into strategic recommendations
  • Fluency in English and Portuguese.


Desired Skills:

  • Fluency in Spanish.
  • SQL, Python, or R.
  • Power BI, Tableau, or other BI tools.
  • Experience with customer analytics, Voice of Customer programs, or customer journey analysis.

title: Analista financeiro II (Financial Analyst)
description:
Sax Trading ( is Hiring a Mid/ Sr Financial Analyst to work full time as an independent contractor.


The ideal candidate will be responsible for using their analytical mindset to analyze and interpret financial data, then relating it to potential business trends and issues. This candidate will feel comfortable using insights they have discovered to communicate important themes and discoveries to company leadership. 

Responsibilities

  • Financial planning: Preparation of budgets, financial projections, and short- and long-term strategic plans. Cash flow control: Monitoring of resources inflows and outflows, ensuring the company's liquidity. 
  • Feasibility analysis: Assessment of investments, projects, and initiatives to determine their profitability and financial impact. 
  •  Management of financial indicators: Tracking KPIs (such as profit margin, ROI, EBITDA) to evaluate financial performance. 
  •  Negotiation with financial institutions: Management of relationships with banks, fundraising, and debt administration. 
  •  Accounting supervision: Ensuring the correct preparation of balance sheets, income statements (DRE), and other accounting reports. 
  •  Compliance with accounting standards: Ensuring that accounting practices are aligned with CPC (Accounting Pronouncements Committee) and IFRS (international standards).
  • Accounting closing: Coordination of monthly, quarterly, and annual closings, ensuring the accuracy of information.
  • Cost management: Analysis and control of operational costs, identifying opportunities for reduction and efficiency improvement.
  • Tax planning: Development of strategies to optimize the tax burden, complying with current legislation.
  • Tax compliance: Ensuring fulfillment of tax obligations, such as submission of declarations (SPED, ECD, ECF) and payment of taxes (ICMS, IPI, PIS/COFINS, IRPJ, CSLL, etc.).
  •  Management of tax risks: Identification and mitigation of risks related to tax assessments or non-compliance.
  •  Monitoring legal changes: Tracking changes in tax legislation to adapt the company's processes.


Qualifications

  • English (C1)- Due report abroad

title: Performance Video Editor - Meta Ads (Remote)
description:
Creative Video Editor - DTC Brand


Location: Fully Remote (must be based in LATAM)

Job Type: Full-Time


Create scroll-stopping content for a scaling DTC brand. We need a performance-focused video editor who can turn raw footage into high-converting ads and social content - with creative freedom and direct feedback loops on what's working.


About Uproot Clean

Uproot Clean is a fast-growing, eco-friendly pet care brand expanding across major retailers like Walmart, Target, and Chewy. Our marketing team is scaling rapidly, and we're looking for a video editor who wants to grow their skills in performance marketing while building a long-term role with a mission-driven company.


The Role

You'll be our go-to editor for short-form video content that drives sales—think Facebook/Instagram ads, TikTok content, and social clips. You'll work with a steady flow of creator and product footage, turning it into thumb-stopping content that performs. This isn't agency churn-and-burn; you'll see what converts, iterate based on data, and refine your craft with real-time feedback.


What You'll Do

Video Editing & Production

  • Create high-performing Facebook/Instagram ad creatives and social media clips
  • Edit short-form content optimized for platform-specific formats
  • Source and organize B-roll and stock footage using the provided subscriptions
  • Manage creator content in Frame.io and maintain organized asset libraries

Graphic Design & Assets

  • Design marketing images, thumbnails, and social graphics
  • Create on-brand visual assets using Photoshop, Illustrator, or Canva

Project Management

  • Track assignments and status updates in ClickUp
  • Follow naming conventions and file organization protocols
  • Communicate proactively about timelines, blockers, and questions


Requirements

  • 3-5+ years of video editing experience, specializing in short-form content
  • Expert-level Adobe Premiere Pro skills (required)
  • Proven experience creating or editing Facebook/Instagram ads
  • Mid-level proficiency with Photoshop, Illustrator, or Canva
  • Strong fundamentals in typography, color theory, composition, and motion graphics
  • Fluent English — excellent written and verbal communication
  • Self-managed — strong time management and ability to meet daily/weekly deadlines
  • Proactive communicator — asks questions early, flags issues before they become problems
  • Portfolio required — you must submit a portfolio showcasing your video editing work. Applications without portfolios will not be considered.


Nice to Have

  • Background in DTC or e-commerce brands
  • Experience with remote collaboration tools (Slack, ClickUp, Frame.io, Notion)
  • Familiarity with performance marketing metrics and what makes ads convert


Tech Requirements

Computer: i7 processor (or equivalent) with 16GB RAM minimum

Internet: 100 Mbps download speed minimum

Schedule

Monday-Friday: 9:00 AM - 6:00 PM EST (1-hour break)

Required: Weekly team meeting on Thursdays at 10:00 AM EST



Benefits & Perks

  • Fully remote - work from anywhere in LATAM
  • Paid time off
  • Flex days. Enjoy an extra quarterly day off to unwind and recharge energies whenever you desire.
  • Professional development - opportunities to learn and grow with the business


Ready to Apply?

If you love creating high-performing video content and have a portfolio that showcases your work, we want to see it. Apply now.

Note: Applications without portfolio samples will not be reviewed.

Job Title: Salesforce System Analyst

Location: Brazil

Duration: 6-12 months with possible extension or FTE conversion


Introduction:

We are seeking a skilled Salesforce System Analyst with 5 to 10 years of experience to join our dynamic team. This role is critical in driving the optimization and enhancement of our Sales Cloud platform, ensuring seamless Salesforce migration , effective Salesforce administration , and robust system configuration and implementation . The Salesforce System Analyst will play a pivotal role in aligning our CRM capabilities with business goals, improving sales processes, and enabling data-driven decision-making across the organization.


Roles and Responsibilities:

  • Lead and manage end-to-end Salesforce migration projects, ensuring data integrity and minimal disruption to business operations.
  • Perform comprehensive Salesforce administration tasks, including user management, security settings, and system maintenance.
  • Configure and customize Sales Cloud features to meet evolving business requirements, including workflows, validation rules, and custom objects.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to gather requirements, analyze business processes, and translate them into scalable technical solutions within Salesforce .
  • Drive the implementation of new Salesforce functionalities and third-party integrations to enhance system capabilities.
  • Monitor system performance and troubleshoot issues to maintain optimal platform efficiency.
  • Develop and maintain detailed documentation related to system configurations, processes, and best practices.
  • Provide training and support to end-users to maximize adoption and utilization of Salesforce tools.
  • Stay updated on the latest Salesforce releases and industry trends to recommend innovative solutions.


Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • 5 to 10 years of proven experience as a Salesforce System Analyst or similar role.
  • Salesforce certifications such as Salesforce Administrator (ADM 201) , Salesforce Platform App Builder , or relevant advanced certifications are highly desirable.
  • Strong understanding of Sales Cloud functionalities and CRM best practices.
  • Demonstrated experience in Salesforce migration , administration, configuration , and implementation projects.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams and manage multiple priorities.


Tools and Technologies:

  • Salesforce Sales Cloud
  • Salesforce Administration tools and features
  • Salesforce Migration tools (e.g., Data Loader, Salesforce DX)
  • Salesforce Configuration and Customization tools (Workflows, Process Builder, Flow Builder)

Sales Cloud, Salesforce migration, Salesforce administration, Configuration, Implementation

Metrobi is a delivery fulfillment platform designed specifically to support local businesses. DESEJÁVEL

O que oferecemos


  • Trabalho com autonomia técnica real — você decide como construir

Role Overview:

The Data Engineer will lead the design, development, and maintenance of scalable data systems that integrate diverse datasets. This role includes deploying AI and machine learning solutions to enhance insights, manage complex data relationships, and drive actionable intelligence for FirstIgnite’s platform. You will mentor and manage a team of data engineers while working cross-functionally to innovate and deliver impactful AI-driven solutions.

  • Evaluate emerging AI/ML techniques and tools to enhance platform capabilities.
  • Maintain version control, CI/CD pipelines, and reproducible workflows for the data engineering team.


Requirements :

  • Strong programming expertise in Python, with experience building production data pipelines.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS data services (Glue/PySpark, Lambda, S3, RDS PostgreSQL, SSM) or equivalent cloud data stacks.
  • Familiarity with RESTful and GraphQL APIs, ETL processes, and data integration strategies.
  • Understanding of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and AI-enhanced data applications.
  • Strong analytical skills, including evaluating trade-offs of data ingestion and storage methods.
  • Leadership experience managing data engineering or AI teams in SaaS or tech environments.
  • Solid knowledge of version control (Git) and CI/CD practices.
  • Exposure to data science / ML libraries (Pandas, Scikit-learn, PyTorch) and managed ML platforms (SageMaker, Vertex AI) is a plus.
  • Excellent problem-solving, collaboration, and communication skills in cross-functional teams.
  • Ability to work independently, prioritize tasks, and drive projects from conception to deployment.


Additional Qualifications:

  • Data quality instrumentation and observability for pipelines.

You will be responsible for the end-to-end management of our GCP infrastructure, from complex networking to proactive cost optimization and resource scaling. The ideal candidate ensures our Compute Engine environment is lean, fast, and resilient while maintaining secure connectivity using both native and third-party VPN solutions.

strategy.

  • Infrastructure & Networking: Configure and maintain robust networking architectures, including Cloud DNS and Cloud NAT.
  • Linux System Administration: Manage and maintain the operating system environment on Compute Engine instances, including patching, configuration management, user account management, and troubleshooting core system issues.
  • VPN Management: Build and manage secure tunnels using Cloud VPN , pfSense virtual appliances, and CloudConnexa (OpenVPN) for flexible remote access.
  • Performance Monitoring: Utilize Google Cloud Operations Suite to monitor Compute Engine health. Identify bottlenecks and tune instances for peak performance.
  • Resource Management: Oversee persistent disks, snapshots, and storage buckets. Ensure high availability while purging unused resources to maintain environment hygiene.
  • Cost Optimization: Actively monitor billing dashboards, implement committed use discounts (CUDs), and right-size underutilized instances to maintain a lean budget.
  • Database Oversight: Provide support for PostgreSQL and Oracle environments, ensuring seamless integration and performance within the GCP ecosystem.
  • Security & Compliance : Enforce IAM roles and security best practices to protect the project perimeter


Required Qualifications

  • Certification: Active Google Cloud Professional DevOps Engineer certification.
  • Containerization Mastery: Strong expertise with Docker for containerizing applications, managing images, and troubleshooting container runtimes.
  • Scripting Mastery: High proficiency in Python or Bash for automating routine infrastructure tasks, reporting, and task scheduling.
  • Networking Expertise: Hands-on experience managing network routing, firewall rules, and site-to-site VPNs using pfSense and CloudConnexa.
  • Cloud Migration & Project Leadership: Proven experience leading and running application and data migrations from AWS to GCP. This includes the capability to own the end-to-end migration project life cycle and drive solutions.
  • Compute Engine Mastery: Deep understanding of VM lifecycles, custom machine types, and auto-scaling.
  • English Proficiency: Advanced English level (B2–C1 or higher)


Nice-to-Have

  • PostgreSQL Expertise: Strong hands-on experience with configuration, optimization, and query tuning.
  • Oracle Expertise: Experience managing or migrating Oracle database environments.
  • Data & Analytics: Familiarity with BigQuery.


We offer

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule).
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Fully remote.

title: AI Evaluation Engineer
description:
About FirstIgnite

FirstIgnite is the AI-powered business development platform for university technology transfer offices (TTOs). We help research institutions turn breakthroughs into partnerships, licenses, and companies by combining deep LLM-driven workflows with the relationships that actually move deals forward. Our product suite spans expert discovery, grants search, and AI-driven outreach — all built on a modern, agentic stack.

We ship fast, we measure everything, and we believe evaluations are the difference between AI features that demo well and AI features that work in production.


The Role

We're hiring an AI Evaluation Engineer to own the quality bar for every LLM-powered feature we ship. You'll design, build, and scale the infrastructure that tells us — with evidence — whether a prompt change, model swap, or agent refactor made things better or worse.

This is a high-leverage role. Every customer-facing AI capability at FirstIgnite flows through your evals. You'll work directly with the Head of Engineering and partner closely with product, applied AI, and the full-stack team to establish evaluation as a first-class discipline across the company.


What You'll Do

  • Build evaluation infrastructure: Design and maintain eval suites using Promptfoo, LLM-as-judge methodologies, and custom harnesses for features like our expert search system, natural language grants search, and AI SDR agents.
  • Define what 'good' means: Partner with product and domain experts to translate fuzzy customer outcomes (\"does this surface the right principal investigator?\") into precise, measurable rubrics.
  • Own the feedback loop: Instrument production traffic, curate golden datasets from real customer interactions, and build pipelines that turn user behavior into regression tests.
  • Ship quickly under uncertainty: We routinely run 48-hour eval sprints for greenfield features with no production traffic. You'll be comfortable bootstrapping quality signal from scratch.
  • Model and prompt evaluation: Run rigorous A/B comparisons across models (OpenAI, Anthropic, open-weight), prompt strategies, and agent architectures. Quantify tradeoffs between cost, latency, and quality.
  • Agent evaluation: Help us measure multi-step agent behavior built on the OpenAI Agents SDK, Vercel AI SDK, and Temporal Cloud — including tool-use correctness, trajectory quality, and end-to-end task completion.
  • Raise the floor for the team: Create templates, documentation, and tooling so every engineer can write and run evals as part of normal development. Evals should feel as natural as unit tests.


Requirements

  • 3+ years of engineering experience, with at least 1 year focused on LLM/ML evaluation, applied AI, or data quality systems.
  • Hands-on experience with LLM evaluation frameworks — Promptfoo, Braintrust, LangSmith, OpenAI Evals, DeepEval, or equivalent in-house tooling.
  • Strong grasp of LLM-as-judge methodology, including its failure modes (position bias, verbosity bias, judge-model drift) and how to mitigate them.
  • Statistical literacy — you know the difference between a real regression and noise, and you can design experiments that answer the question actually being asked.
  • Product instincts. You can sit with a customer success call transcript, identify the three failure modes that matter, and ship an eval for each by end of week.
  • Strong written communication. Evals are useless if the engineers shipping features don't trust or read the results.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience evaluating retrieval systems (RAG, hybrid search, reranking) — especially over structured or semi-structured domains like research, grants, or patents.
  • Exposure to agent orchestration frameworks (Temporal, LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK) and the specific challenges of evaluating multi-step, tool-using systems.
  • Background in information retrieval, search relevance, or a research-adjacent domain.
  • Experience building internal tooling or dashboards that non-engineers (PMs, domain experts) actually use to label and review model outputs.


Why This Role

  • You'll be the first dedicated evals hire. The scope, standards, and tooling are yours to define.
  • AI quality is existential for our product. This isn't a compliance role tucked into a corner — it's directly on the critical path to revenue.
  • Small, senior team. ~10 engineers, distributed globally, with a strong bias toward shipping and measuring.
  • Direct access to real-world, high-stakes LLM use cases — research discovery, grants, outbound — across a customer base that deeply values accuracy.


This is a fully remote position. We have engineers across the Americas, Europe, and Africa. Overlap with US working hours is expected.

title: Lead Generation Specialist
description:
The pay for this role will be between USD 693 to 850/month, depending on experience.


About Us

Publicity For Good (PFG) is a US-based, female-founded public relations agency that partners with impact-driven, heart-centered leaders and purpose-driven CPG brands (Food & Beverage, Fashion, and Beauty). We are an all-female team dedicated to amplifying brands that make a difference through meaningful visibility and measurable growth. We operate in a fun, fast-paced environment where collaboration creates magic.


Role

This position is responsible for generating and nurturing qualified leads with the primary objective of booking sales calls. The Lead Generation Specialist will manage inbound and outbound lead channels, validate prospect interest, coordinate with the sales team, and maintain an organized pipeline across multiple platforms.


As a Lead Generation Specialist , you will monitor and respond to leads from various sources including Meta ads, Leadhype, Smartlead, and GoHighLevel (GHL). You will conduct call show audits, manage follow-up sequences, update pipeline statuses, and ensure seamless handoff of qualified prospects to the sales team. This role requires strong communication skills, exceptional organization, and the ability to work independently across multiple systems while maintaining high response rates and booking quality.


Responsibilities

  • Monitor and respond to new leads across all platforms (GHL, Leadhype, Smartlead, Meta ads).
  • Conduct daily call show audits and update show/no-show statuses in tracking systems.
  • Manage and update the Airtable Lead Gen dashboard with accurate lead data and metrics.
  • Qualify inbound leads and schedule sales calls with interested prospects.
  • Execute manual follow-ups for warm leads and re-engagement campaigns.
  • Review and respond to positive replies from Leadhype and Smartlead outreach campaigns.
  • Update lead tags, statuses, and ownership in GHL based on prospect engagement and stage.
  • Maintain accurate pipeline management and ensure all conversations are properly categorized.
  • Coordinate reschedules for no-show prospects and maintain consistent follow-up cadence.
  • Process and segment new Meta ads leads into appropriate workflows.
  • Review notes from sales reps in GHL and take necessary follow-up actions.
  • Update sales team on lead status changes, show/no-show patterns, and booking confirmations.
  • Track daily lead generation metrics including new conversations, responses, and bookings.
  • Identify and flag low-quality leads or technical issues with lead sources.
  • Maintain organized conversation threads and ensure timely responses to all inquiries.
  • Collaborate with Sales and Marketing teams to improve lead quality and conversion rates.
  • Test and optimize messaging templates across platforms to improve response rates.
  • Ensure all lead generation software and integrations function properly.


Results

  • Consistently meet or exceed monthly sales call booking targets.
  • Maintain high response rates across all lead channels (within 1-2 hours for new leads).
  • Deliver accurate and timely daily reports on lead generation activities and pipeline status.
  • Ensure qualified leads are properly nurtured and handed off to sales with complete context.
  • Identify trends in lead quality, response rates, and show/no-show patterns.
  • Maintain an organized and up-to-date pipeline with proper tagging and segmentation.
  • Support predictable sales pipeline through consistent lead flow and booking quality.
  • Reduce lead leakage by ensuring no prospect falls through the cracks.
  • Contribute to improved conversion rates through effective qualification and pre-call preparation.


Requirements

  • Prior experience in lead generation, sales development, or appointment setting of at least 2 years.
  • Strong written communication skills with ability to engage prospects effectively.
  • Experience with CRM platforms, especially GoHighLevel (GHL), or similar tools.
  • Familiarity with lead generation platforms such as Leadhype, Smartlead, or comparable systems.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple lead sources and prioritize high-value opportunities.
  • Highly organized with excellent attention to detail and time management skills.
  • Self-motivated and able to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Comfortable working with data, tracking metrics, and identifying performance patterns.
  • Experience with Airtable, Google Workspace, and project management tools preferred.
  • Strong technical aptitude and ability to quickly learn new platforms and systems.
  • Results-driven mindset with focus on meeting and exceeding KPIs.
  • Ability to handle high-volume communication while maintaining quality and personalization.
  • Professional, persistent, and positive attitude with strong problem-solving skills.
  • Discretion in handling sensitive prospect and client information.
  • Adaptability to changing priorities and willingness to optimize processes continuously.


The pay for this role will be between USD 693 to 850/month, depending on experience.

Position Overview

The BMP (Business Model and Pricing) Analytics team is seeking an experienced Data Engineer to support business performance management and strategic decision-making through scalable data infrastructure and engineering solutions. The team partners closely with leadership, finance, operations, and business stakeholders to enable reliable, high-quality data access, support advanced analytics, and drive data-informed actions across the organization.

You have a strong engineering and problem-solving mindset. You translate business and analytical needs into scalable, reliable data solutions and architectures.

You collaborate closely with analytics, data science, and business teams to ensure data availability, quality, and usability for dashboards, reporting, and advanced analyses.

You contribute to the design and evolution of the data and ML ecosystem, helping establish the infrastructure, processes, and foundations required to scale AI/ML initiatives across the organization.
